metaTitle: Custom Good Value Lanyards | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Good Value lanyards in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Durable, affordable, and ideal for events, offices, and more.
introHtml: Good Value lanyards deliver reliable, budget-friendly branding for events, schools, and corporate offices. Made from durable polyester with a smooth finish, these lanyards hold badges, keys, or ID cards securely. Choose from multiple attachment options like badge holders or key rings, and add your logo with full-color screen printing or woven text. For bulk orders needing a professional look without stretching the budget, Good Value lanyards offer a practical, consistent solution.
heroAltText: Bulk custom Good Value lanyards with printed logos and metal clips for ID badges
